text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is here, and an
unexpected
visitor shows up in the
waiting room while Narita
Taishin is
away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's Нарита Таисин's mother who, after
telling me
of her complicated
relationship with her
daughter, entrusts
me with a bouquet of flowers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When Нарита Таисин returns, I tell her
the flowers
are from a fan, but she
immediately sees through
the lie.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She tells me that she doesn't care
whether or not
her mother is watching.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She'll simply run, like she always does,
and win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
